keyframe_review.note: New keyframe 1843-1851: after Arroyo Grande (6 December 1842) 'Oribe laid siege to Montevideo' (the Uruguay page dates the siege from February 1843), and the Gobierno del Cerrito under Manuel Oribe governed the rest of the country (1843-1851) while the Gobierno de la Defensa under Joaquin Suarez governed Montevideo (1843-1852). The page gives no map of the interior: all of Uruguay except the city and department of Montevideo is the researcher's reading.

notes:
Civil-war state Cliopatria lacks: the Blanco government of Manuel Oribe that held the interior of Uruguay while the Colorado Defence government held Montevideo (1843-1851). Two pages (Uruguayan Civil War, Uruguay). The Defence government is treated as the Uruguayan state (its dossier is oriental-republic-of-uruguay), the Cerrito government as the rebel; the pages treat both as claiming legitimacy, and Rosas of Buenos Aires backed Oribe. The pages give no front line, so the interior is 'Uruguay minus Montevideo'. The Wikipedia and Wikidata ids are null; the Cerrito article was not opened.
